source: HiRISE DEM of Gale crater (Gale_DEM_SMG_1m, 1 m) cropped to a 10 x 10 km area, resampled to 4 m by the Python pipeline, then every 4th cell (16 m)
origin: x east, y south, metres from the north-west corner of the area; row 0 = north

texture.source: USGS Astrogeology 'Mars MSL Gale Merged Orthophoto Mosaic 25cm' HiRISE LRGB colour mosaic, cropped to the area (where the colour mosaic has no data, ESTIMATED colour: a brightness -> colour table learned from this area's real colour pixels, not measured). Processed, NOT a true-colour photo
texture.authors: T. Parker, F. J. Calef III (USGS)

minerals.source: MRO CRISM MTRDR summary parameters, 5 FRT observations: frt00021c92, frt0000b6f1, frt0001ca91, frt0001bba1, frt000058a3 (100.0% coverage). A pixel is a detection when the 3x3-smoothed index is above 0.010 (Min_trial pipeline, mineral_layers)
